title: Checkout DB Connection Timeout Tuning
decision_quote: We are optimizing the PostgreSQL connection pool timeout from 30s to 5s with backoff in PR #236.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Peak load concurrency is hitting timeout limits on payments/checkout.py. Issue #44 is tracking this.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: PR #326 claimed to address it, but that was just docs. We need real connection pool tuning.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Decision: We are optimizing the PostgreSQL connection pool timeout from 30s to 5s with backoff in PR #236.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: LGTM. Tested under synthetic load and verified latency dropped 45%.

title: Batch Settlement Pipeline Refactor
decision_quote: We are deprecating and removing reconcile_unsettled_batches() in favor of event-driven settlement in PR #238.

messages.author: lucas-vogel
messages.text: Earlier we agreed to maintain reconcile_unsettled_batches() for backwards compatibility in runbooks.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Reversal: We are deprecating and removing reconcile_unsettled_batches() in favor of event-driven settlement in PR #238.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Noted, runbook docs/runbooks/payment-pipeline-recovery.md will need updating since it still cites the old batch function.

title: Stateless JWT vs Redis Session Store
decision_quote: We are adopting signed Ed25519 asymmetric JWT tokens for all microservice authentication.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Evaluating token structure for auth/ endpoints.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Decision: We are adopting signed Ed25519 asymmetric JWT tokens for all microservice authentication.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Documenting in docs/adr/0002-token-auth.md.

title: Rate Limiting Architecture
decision_quote: We are going with per-tenant rate limits.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Initial RFC proposed global IP-based rate limiting across all auth gateway endpoints.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Global IP limits broke enterprise NAT gateways in staging testing yesterday.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Reversal: We are abandoning IP-based limits; we are going with per-tenant rate limits in PR #237.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Agreed. Per-tenant bucket algorithm isolates noisy neighbors without blocking enterprise egress IPs.

title: MFA Enforcement Policy
decision_quote: Mandatory WebAuthn or TOTP MFA is required for all engineering console and API credential operations.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Security audit requires hard enforcement on administrative and payment-touching routes.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Decision: Mandatory WebAuthn or TOTP MFA is required for all engineering console and API credential operations.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Formalized under ADR-0008.

title: Logging Pipeline Architecture
decision_quote: All production services must stream logs via OpenTelemetry OTLP over gRPC directly to the collector, bypassing stdout.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: ADR-0003 mandated standard stdout JSON logging for container runtimes.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Stdout logging docker daemon buffer saturated during Kafka replay spikes.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Reversal: All production services must stream logs via OpenTelemetry OTLP over gRPC directly to the collector, bypassing stdout.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Confirmed, documented in ADR-0007 superseding ADR-0003.

title: PostgreSQL Sharding Strategy
decision_quote: We are partitioning payment transactional ledger tables by tenant ID hash across 16 database shards.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Reviewing cluster scale projections for the next 18 months.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Decision: We are partitioning payment transactional ledger tables by tenant ID hash across 16 database shards.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Documented in docs/adr/0005-database-sharding.md.

title: Search Engine Backend Selection
decision_quote: We are migrating search/ from PostgreSQL tsvector to distributed OpenSearch to support sub-50ms fuzzy queries.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: We originally prototyped search/ using PostgreSQL tsvector full-text indices.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Reversal: We are migrating search/ from PostgreSQL tsvector to distributed OpenSearch to support sub-50ms fuzzy queries.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Assigned Issue #88 to track the cluster rollout.

title: Secondary Payment Gateway Failover
decision_quote: We are enabling active-active multi-acquirer failover routing for Stripe and Adyen in PR #189.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Single gateway dependency caused 12 minutes downtime during upstream provider outage.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Decision: We are enabling active-active multi-acquirer failover routing for Stripe and Adyen in PR #189.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Merged and verified in staging.

title: Merchant Webhook Dispatch Architecture
decision_quote: Abandoning direct HTTP worker calls; routing all outbound merchant webhooks through SQS dead-letter queues in PR #212.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: We were using synchronous HTTP calls from workers to dispatch merchant webhooks.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Reversal: Abandoning direct HTTP worker calls; routing all outbound merchant webhooks through SQS dead-letter queues in PR #212.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Huge reliability win, no more blocked worker threads on slow merchant endpoints.

title: Experimentation Engine Architecture
decision_quote: We are implementing client-side MurmurHash3 bucketing with deterministic seed evaluation in growth/experiments/.

messages.author: aiden-cross
messages.text: Need low-latency feature flagging for A/B rollout experiments.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Decision: We are implementing client-side MurmurHash3 bucketing with deterministic seed evaluation in growth/experiments/.

messages.author: aiden-cross
messages.text: Deployed in PR #155.

title: Referral Bonus Allocation Logic
decision_quote: We are removing instant referral payout and enforcing a 14-day anti-fraud maturation lock in PR #204.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Instant referral credit granting was exploited by disposable email bot rings.

messages.author: aiden-cross
messages.text: Reversal: We are removing instant referral payout and enforcing a 14-day anti-fraud maturation lock in PR #204.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Fraudulent credit claims dropped to zero immediately.

title: Event Serialization Standards
decision_quote: All Kafka event producers must register Protobuf v3 schemas with strict backwards compatibility checks in CI.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Uncoordinated schema changes in billing payloads broke downstream ingestion twice this month.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Decision: All Kafka event producers must register Protobuf v3 schemas with strict backwards compatibility checks in CI.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Published ADR-0004.

title: Kubernetes Secret Provider Migration
decision_quote: Decommissioning git-crypt in favor of HashiCorp Vault with automated 30-day token rotation in Issue #120.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Previously we stored encrypted secrets directly in git using git-crypt.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Reversal: Decommissioning git-crypt in favor of HashiCorp Vault with automated 30-day token rotation in Issue #120.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: All clusters migrated successfully.

title: Internal Service-to-Service Protocol
decision_quote: All internal East-West RPC communication between microservices must use gRPC over HTTP/2 with mTLS.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Internal JSON over HTTP/1.1 is consuming excessive CPU on serialization.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Decision: All internal East-West RPC communication between microservices must use gRPC over HTTP/2 with mTLS.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Documented in ADR-0006.

title: Floating Point vs Integer Currency Representation
decision_quote: Prohibiting all float math for monetary values; all amounts must be stored as 64-bit integer minor currency units in PR #112.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Legacy billing modules represented amounts in floating point decimal strings.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Reversal: Prohibiting all float math for monetary values; all amounts must be stored as 64-bit integer minor currency units in PR #112.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Precision discrepancies resolved completely.

title: Backchannel Logout & Token Revocation
decision_quote: Implementing OpenID Connect Backchannel Logout and Redis revocation bloom filters in PR #176.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Need instant token revocation when a user changes their password.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Decision: Implementing OpenID Connect Backchannel Logout and Redis revocation bloom filters in PR #176.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Verified revocation propagates in under 20ms across all gateways.

title: Email Dispatch Worker Architecture
decision_quote: Decoupling user registration from notification delivery by routing via RabbitMQ dead-letter queues in PR #221.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Notifications worker was executing synchronously in request thread during user onboarding.

messages.author: aiden-cross
messages.text: Reversal: Decoupling user registration from notification delivery by routing via RabbitMQ dead-letter queues in PR #221.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Onboarding latency reduced from 850ms to 42ms.

title: OpenTelemetry Trace Sampling Rate
decision_quote: Setting adaptive tail-based sampling to 5% for HTTP 200 responses and 100% for error status codes in PR #198.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: 100% trace capture is overwhelming our Grafana Tempo storage.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Decision: Setting adaptive tail-based sampling to 5% for HTTP 200 responses and 100% for error status codes in PR #198.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Storage overhead dropped 80% while retaining full visibility on 5xx incidents.

title: PgBouncer vs In-App Pooling
decision_quote: Eliminating in-process connection pools in favor of a centralized PgBouncer pooler in transaction mode in PR #231.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: We previously configured in-process connection pools inside each ECS container task.

messages.author: caleb-rivers
messages.text: Reversal: Eliminating in-process connection pools in favor of a centralized PgBouncer pooler in transaction mode in PR #231.

messages.author: clara-oswald
messages.text: Max DB connections dropped from 1,200 to 120.

title: API Idempotency Standard
decision_quote: All POST requests modifying financial balance must supply a unique Idempotency-Key header cached in Redis for 24 hours.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Network retries from client apps occasionally caused duplicate charge authorizations.

messages.author: marcus-vance
messages.text: Decision: All POST requests modifying financial balance must supply a unique Idempotency-Key header cached in Redis for 24 hours.

messages.author: elena-rostova
messages.text: Documented in ADR-0001.

title: Web Session TTL Adjustment
decision_quote: Shortening maximum web session lifespan to 12 hours with a mandatory 15-minute idle inactivity lock in PR #165.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Initial web session TTL was 30 days without idle timeout.

messages.author: priya-sharma
messages.text: Reversal: Shortening maximum web session lifespan to 12 hours with a mandatory 15-minute idle inactivity lock in PR #165.

messages.author: gabriel-santos
messages.text: Aligns with SOC2 compliance requirements.

title: Design System Token Integration
decision_quote: Adopting CSS custom property design tokens strictly compiled from Figma design tokens in PR #178.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Frontend design system tokens need standardization across React apps.

messages.author: aiden-cross
messages.text: Decision: Adopting CSS custom property design tokens strictly compiled from Figma design tokens in PR #178.

messages.author: maya-lin
messages.text: Looks great, full theme switching supported.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: Using local runner directory caching was causing cache invalidation bugs in GitHub Actions.

messages.author: liam-chen
messages.text: Reversal: Replacing local runner directory caching with remote buildx registry inline cache in Issue #140.

messages.author: sophia-rossi
messages.text: CI pipeline build times dropped from 14 minutes to 3.5 minutes.
